contract.description: Return whether abs(observed - target) is no greater than tolerance. The tolerance boundary is inclusive.
contract.domain: Numeric arguments are finite, between -1000 and 1000, with no negative-zero inputs. Inputs are unchanged. Tolerance is nonnegative.
contract.outputRole: whether the absolute deviation is at most tolerance
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
